root_cause: Two logically-independent bit-fields (pauserehash and useStoredKeyApi) inside struct dict share the same underlying storage unit, so a write to one requires a non-atomic read-modify-write that can race with a concurrent read/write of the other. This latent structural hazard became an actual exploitable/observable data race once PR #13696 introduced concurrent, unsynchronized access to the command dict (server.commands) from I/O threads via lookupCommand()->dictFind(), racing with the main thread's rehash-pause bookkeeping on the same dict.
